name: HTMLvault
description:
Claude and other AI tools generate HTML constantly, from reports to landing pages to prototypes, but there's no easy way to share it or know if anyone looked. HTMLvault turns any HTML into a clean, trackable link in seconds: visitors, geography, device, referrer, time on page.

Through this connector, Claude can publish links one at a time or in bulk from a template, edit or delete them, and pull analytics, all without leaving the conversation. Draft something, say "vault this," and get back a link ready to send.

Every link is also scanned for PII and secrets before it publishes (Enterprise: your own AI scanning on top), with password protection and configurable retention available. Free: 50 links/month, 30-day expiry. Pro/Enterprise: unlimited links, edit after publishing, and white-label with your own domain. Full reference: htmlvault.com/docs/mcp.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HTMLvault to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HTMLvault to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://htmlvault.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HTMLvault MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HTMLvault provides these MCP tools: create_link, create_recipient_links, delete_link, get_analytics, get_link, list_links, scan_html, update_link, patch_link, and create_links.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HTMLvault?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HTMLvault in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
HTMLvault requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HTMLvault is developed by HTMLvault. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
